vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical Sciences, including the integrated PG Degrees. Experience required: Research experience in clinical trials and working knowledge of biostatistics and/or PhD is desirable. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: 56000 + 20% HRA. Qualification required: Three years Graduate degree in Psychology or Social Work + three years’ post-qualification experience OR Postgraduate degree in Psychology or Social Work. Experience required: Three years’ post-qualification experience for graduates. M.Phil in clinical Psychology, experience in clinical research and administering psychological rating scales are desirable. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: 28000 + 20% HRA.

content_sections.text: Purely temporary and contractual basis for 11 months initially. Extension up to a maximum of 3 years or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, based on requirements and satisfactory performance. May be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice.

content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates Proof of date of birth Experience certificates One recent passport-size photograph Identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving Licence) One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents SC/ST/OBC/Disability certificate, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format attached with the notification. Upload the completed application through the Google Form on or before 08/11/2026, 05.00 PM. Submit separate applications if applying for more than one post.

content_sections.text: Hard copies of the application or documents are not required at the application stage. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), 1 Project Technical Support - III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PwD As per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 56000 + 20% HRA for Project Research Scientist – I (Non-Medical), 28000 + 20% HRA for Project Technical Support - III.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate Degree in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical Sciences OR Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Psychology or Social Work. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No hostel or other accommodation will be provided by the institute. An undertaking regarding non-admissibility of benefits like Provident Fund, Pension, Leave Travel Concession and medical reimbursement must be submitted at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons already in regular time-scale service under any Government Department/Organisation. Candidates who fail to produce original certificates at joining.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening and shortlisting of applications. Walk-In-Interview/personal discussion for shortlisted candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Walk-In-Interview/personal discussion.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and contractual basis for 11 months initially. Extension up to a maximum of 3 years or completion of the project, whichever is earlier, based on requirements and satisfactory performance. May be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice.
